name: user-john-profile
description: John's interests, background and skills (video games, CS:GO, Witcher 3, Cyberpunk 2077, FIFA 23, chess incl. regional tournament win, board games, online board game demo with game developer, drums, programming class, programming seminar organizer, online programming group, online competition with programmer friends, freelance web work, coding blog, HTML/CSS, VR, metal detecting, travel, pets, food, charity events incl. children's hospital tournament, non-profit volunteering, game dev non-profit mentor gig, new job, gaming tournament organizing career, football, sci-fi/fantasy books, reading to relax, family incl. parents and siblings, gaming gear, portable smokers startup, first mobile game)

John is a big video game fan; games help him relax and escape stress after a long day or in tough times. As of 17 March 2022 he just signed up for a programming class. He did some HTML and CSS a few years ago and wants to refresh those skills. He has tried VR gaming a few times and finds it very immersive. He doesn't like bowling (says his fingers are too big) and is thinking of taking up morning runs.

As of 20 March 2022 he has a new hobby: metal detecting on beaches (bought a detector). Finds so far: mostly bottle caps, a few coins, and once a gold ring. He would love a pet but isn't ready yet ("someday"); James offered to help him find one.

As of 27 March 2022: John plays drums (about a month, started ~late Feb 2022; tough but fun). His favorite game is CS:GO; he recently attended a gaming convention, tried many games, met developers and played in a CS:GO tournament, which inspired him to improve. He advanced to the next level in a game the week before (~20 Mar). He stays motivated by setting goals and wants to keep improving at gaming and hobbies.

As of 12 April 2022: work has been busy and he's made little gaming-goal progress. He is playing a new futuristic dystopia RPG with a great story and world, tough gameplay, and some lag/bugs.

As of 20 April 2022: on 12 April 2022 he met three new friends in his programming course who share his passion. He went to a canyon around 18 April 2022 to be alone with nature. Believes "only those who rest well work well"; friends and travel motivate him. Last country visited was Japan (loved the tech-heavy megacities, big screens, street food). Dreams of visiting Italy.

As of 23 April 2022: work is very hectic with deadlines; he is stuck on a difficult coding assignment (trying to make a new algorithm work better) and frustrated, but resolved to keep going, break it into smaller steps and ask for help. Wishes he could spend more time in nature.

As of 29 April 2022: he is doing freelance programming to hone his skills; his first professional project outside class is a website for a local small business. Progress is slow with hiccups; setting up online payments on the site was the hard part (using resources, getting closer). He is currently playing AC Valhalla, likes strategy games, played a card game (Uno-like) and an impostor-style social game with friends. He enjoys fantasy novels and recommended "The Name of the Wind" to James.

As of 4 May 2022: had a day off and hosted a few new friends for a movie afternoon; he's trying to socialize more and balance work and enjoyment. Favourite pizza is Hawaiian (sweet and salty); hasn't tried prosciutto yet but will.

As of 8 May 2022: on 7 May 2022 John and friends organized a CS:GO charity tournament with a big turnout. Money went to a dog shelter near his street; leftover funds bought groceries and food cooked for the homeless. He wants to organize more events combining gaming and helping the community.

As of 11 May 2022: John volunteered his programming skills for a charitable foundation that helps kids, replacing their paper/manual inventory records with a smartphone app (inventory, resources, donations tracking, reports). It gave him a strong sense of purpose; he is now considering volunteer roles and possibly a non-profit career, but hasn't yet looked for a specific organization.

As of 23 May 2022: on Friday 20 May 2022 he entered a local tournament and took second place, winning prize money and a trophy.

As of 13 June 2022: John got his dream job offer after many interviews and starts in July 2022. He is a Manchester City fan and made a bet with James (a Liverpool fan) that City will finish higher than Liverpool in the final standings next season.

As of 16 June 2022: John started a blog about coding around 9 June 2022 (exciting but a bit scary; he enjoys sharing his coding journey and connecting with other coders). He recently bought many books and his bookcase is almost full. He loves sci-fi and epic fantasy with immersive world-building; favorites: "The Stormlight Archive", "Kingkiller Chronicle", and "The Expanse" (SF). He described the past period as an emotional rollercoaster.

As of 19 June 2022: John is thinking about his career and wants to make a positive impact; he is looking into volunteering and non-profit work. He accepted James's offer to visit James's volunteering organization (items for the less fortunate) the weekend of 25-26 June 2022.

As of 9 July 2022: John feels both determined/passionate and overwhelmed/stressed, finding personal/professional balance challenging. He relaxes by reading, loving the imaginative worlds of authors.

As of 22 July 2022: John just started playing chess to improve at strategy and decision-making; he plays mostly online and joined a chess club. He has a partner/person named Jill and siblings whose support matters to him. He still has no pets but says he'll get one someday. He and James were friends as kids (skateboarding together at age 10).

As of 6 August 2022: John recently left his IT job of 3 years to do something that made a difference and aligned with his values; he loves the new job. He is now drawn to the gaming industry and wants a career as an organizer of computer game tournaments in his state (e.g. CS:GO, also Fortnite). He has already made some connections and plans to gain experience and perfect his skills. James offered financial help/advice if needed.

As of 10 August 2022: John is now playing strategy and RPG games besides his usual shooters (encouraged by James) and is thinking of organizing competitions for those genres too. He is hooked on The Witcher 3 (loves story, characters, shaping the world by choices; he had earlier not played it yet). He showed James his newly organized workplace with wall lighting.

As of 21 August 2022: John joined an online programming group (tech for good) on Friday 19 August 2022, exchanged contacts and did a one-off project with a member the week before; he says it's a one-time experience, not a return to programming focus, and he is still committed to hosting eSports competitions. He bought new devices and refurbished his gaming desk; setup is a gaming PC with powerful graphics card, gaming chair, keyboard, headset. His siblings live far away; as kids they had an all-night gaming marathon, and he is organizing a gaming night with them in September 2022.

As of 26 August 2022: John's younger siblings joined a programming course and he is helping them; together they work on a simple text-based adventure game to learn coding. He doesn't like dark beer (prefers light beers). 27 August 2022 is his day off; he planned to meet James at McGee's Pub.

As of 1 September 2022: John is teaching his siblings coding; they're making basic games and stories and learning fast. He said he is going through some difficult times (unspecified) and values James's friendship and support.

As of 4 September 2022: John's parents just started learning coding from him (his father wrote his first program); it brings them closer. He bought new gaming gear: Sennheiser headphones and a Logitech mouse. He accepted James's invite to a baseball game on Sunday 11 September 2022.

As of 18 September 2022: John got into board games; tried "Dungeons of the Dragon" the week before (~11 Sep) and found it very fun. He likes electronic and rock music, and says he played drums when younger but hasn't in a while (earlier notes said he'd just started drums in Feb 2022). He has jammed with friends but never recorded it.

As of 20 September 2022: John started a startup on 19 September 2022 making portable smokers (already welded one from metal). He also finished his first mobile game, a 2D adventure with puzzles and exploration, launching in October 2022; he kept it secret for months in case it fell through. He used a game design book for the puzzles, plus tutorials, developer forums and a game dev magazine. He will let James test it. His week was chaotic but he's powering through and promised to make time for himself.

As of 3 October 2022: John got an email offering a volunteer gig at a game dev non-profit, as a programming mentor for game developers (teaching coding, assisting with projects). He sees it as a possible start to a career combining gaming and helping others. He has played Cyberpunk 2077 and loved it (immersive world, story).

As of 13 October 2022: around 6 October 2022 John and his programmer friends organized an online competition (he had a blast watching everyone show off skills).

As of 21 October 2022: John organized a programming seminar ~14 October 2022 (great turnout, learned new programming approaches/techniques; hasn't tried them yet). He plans to send James resources/tutorials on them. He advised James on Cyberpunk 2077: dialogue choices can be life-changing and you needn't befriend every character.

As of 31 October 2022: John held a charity gaming tournament with friends on 30 October 2022 (Fortnite, Overwatch, Apex Legends) raising money for a children's hospital; he loved combining gaming and a good cause.

As of 5 November 2022: John won a regional chess tournament on Tuesday 1 November 2022 (strategy: analyze and anticipate opponent's moves; advises studying openings and past games). He sent James chess opening resources. He is currently hooked on FIFA 23 (online play) and plans to play it with James once James practices (needs a gamepad).

As of 7 November 2022: over the weekend (~5-6 Nov) John collaborated with a game developer on an online board game based on his ideas; a demo is coming soon and he'll tell James when it's out. He still has no dog but really wants one; his cousin has a dog named Luna.

---
name: project-james-friend-and-plans
description: James (John's childhood friend, gaming/programming), his projects, released first game (Oct 2022), tournaments, pets, travel, food, football, volunteering, extreme sports, dating Samantha (moving in together, Oct 2022), cooking class, gaming group, streaming, dreams/notebook, music, new video card/Cyberpunk (started playing 20 Oct 2022), childhood Nintendo, road trip Nov 2022 (animal sanctuary), FIFA 23 plan, and joint plans like VR, a dog app, a trip next year, a baseball game, testing John's mobile game and board game demo

---
James is a friend John chats with. He loves video games (currently The Witcher 3), bowling, and has two dogs, Max and Daisy (they know sit, stay, paw, rollover; he trained them and treats them like family). He knows Python and C++, has built a website and game mods. He is making a computer game from a comic character he sketched as a kid, and keeps goals in a notebook. He may invite John to help with HTML parts of the game.

As of 20 March 2022 James made a game avatar and joined a new online gaming platform where he chats with other gamers and shares tips; he is also trying different game styles. He says gaming is like therapy for him when overwhelmed. He offered to help John find a pet when John is ready.

As of 27 March 2022: James started learning a musical instrument a few days earlier (practicing daily, improving; John plays drums too, so a shared interest). He got a new cutting-edge gaming system with great graphics and is exploring RPGs and strategy games; he stays motivated with small goals and progress tracking.

As of 4 April 2022: James joined an online gaming tournament on 3 April 2022 and reached the semifinals but didn't make the final. He met the whole team, got autographs and tips (communicate well, never put ego above team success). He uses voice chat with his team. His favourite game is Apex Legends. He is thinking of trying RPGs or MOBAs.

As of 12 April 2022: James adopted a pup named Ned from a shelter in Stamford around 5 April 2022 (so now has three dogs). John told him about a new futuristic dystopia RPG (great story/graphics, but laggy and buggy) and promised to send a link; James will try it and report back. James prefers waiting for bugs to be fixed but was convinced.

As of 20 April 2022: on 14 April 2022 James worked with a gaming pal on a programming project, building a Witcher 3-inspired virtual world; he made a game character modeled on a woman he saw on a dog walk ~6 April 2022 and was smitten with but didn't approach. He has travelled to Italy (2021), Turkey and Mexico. He and John agreed to plan a trip together next year (2023); James will look for a destination and John offered help.

As of 23 April 2022: James took his dogs hiking on Thursday 21 April 2022 (trails, views); he enjoys nature to clear his head. He offered John coding help (suggested breaking problems into steps, researching similar algorithms, asking other programmers).

As of 29 April 2022: James bought a fantasy adventure art book ~26 April 2022 and likes the genre; John recommended "The Name of the Wind". James has been playing the strategy game Civilization VI for about a month (enjoys the planning/problem-solving). His dogs often watch him game (Daisy cuddled up). He's been meaning to try the impostor-style party game.

As of 4 May 2022: on Friday 29 April 2022 a code bug broke the game mechanics in James's weeks-long project; he couldn't fix it alone, but a group of friends teamed up and fixed it. Daisy is a Labrador; the other two dogs are shepherds. He says pets, computer games, travel and pizza bring him happiness. Favourite pizza: pepperoni; also likes cheese and prosciutto (urged John to try prosciutto and report back). John invited him to join future movie nights with John's new friends; James said he's in.

As of 23 May 2022: James went to an amusement park the weekend of 14-15 May 2022 with friends (roller coasters, Ferris wheel, electric cars, buggies). In April 2022 he finished a big months-long project, which required learning a new language; he feels more confident for bigger projects.

As of 13 June 2022: James recently started a course combining gaming and programming; they're working on a football simulator and he built the player databases. He is a devoted Liverpool fan (never misses a match, hopes they win the league next season). He and John (Man City fan) bet on whose team finishes higher in the final standings next season.

As of 16 June 2022: James said recent events were mixed (some good, some not so great) and that he has at least two people who reliably support him. Max loves swimming (beach or lake) and catching frisbees mid-air. James walks Max on a trail a mile from his house, often bringing a book to relax. John recommended "The Stormlight Archive", "Kingkiller Chronicle" and "The Expanse" to him; James said he'll check them out.

As of 19 June 2022: on Friday 17 June 2022 James began introducing Max, Daisy and Ned to each other; hard at first but they are adapting and bonding. He volunteered in May 2022 with an organization that provides necessary items/gifts to the less fortunate, and offered to take John there the weekend of 25-26 June 2022 and introduce him to staff; no interview needed, just friendliness and desire to help.

As of 9 July 2022: James won an online gaming tournament in the week before (~early July 2022), which motivated him to keep improving. He's become interested in extreme sports (rope jumping from 150 m ~8 July; surfing ~6 July) as a way to take breaks from hobbies. He bought tickets to Toronto, leaving the evening of 11 July 2022, also plans to visit Vancouver and maybe elsewhere, returning 20 July 2022 (promised John a souvenir); it will be his fourth country visited.

As of 22 July 2022: James's trip went great; he also visited Nuuk (Greenland), adding another country, and brought souvenirs for John and Jill. He and John have been friends since childhood (skateboarding at ~10; James still skateboards and taught his dogs to balance on/chase the board). James has a sister who visited with him and the dogs ~21 July 2022. James gave chess tips (study openings, analyze own games). He was tired after the last two days.

As of 6 August 2022: James took his puppy to the clinic on 5 August 2022 for a routine checkup and vaccination against a seasonal canine disease. He says his pets are the source of his joy. He supports John's career change and offered financial help/advice if needed.

As of 10 August 2022: on 9 August 2022 James took his three dogs to a beach outing with other dog owners and met a woman named Samantha, who gave him her phone number; he planned to call her on 11 August 2022 to ask her on a date.

As of 21 August 2022: James isn't in any online groups but regularly plays with a gaming group that streams sessions; they recently had a get-together, and he hosted an all-night gaming marathon with friends. His setup: gaming PC, keyboard, mouse, comfy chair.

As of 26 August 2022: James now wants to create his own strategy game like Civilization (has been trying different genres). Ned is the pup adopted in April. He proposed meeting John on 27 August 2022; they settled on McGee's Pub (light beers, since John dislikes dark beer).

As of 1 September 2022: James finished his Unity strategy game (inspired by Civilization and Total War); challenges were balancing mechanics/fairness; lessons: perseverance, patience, feedback and collaboration. He told John he's there to talk/vent if needed.

As of 4 September 2022: James asked Samantha to be his girlfriend on 3 September 2022 at the theater (she loves theater) and she said yes. They also went to McGee's bar (she loves lager). He and Samantha invited John to a baseball game on Sunday 11 September 2022 (John accepted; James will show him Samantha). James signed up for a cooking class ~2 September 2022 ($10/class; made omelette, meringue, dough) and hopes to cook for John later.

As of 18 September 2022: James has been very busy and now writes everything he needs to do in a notebook. He gets ideas from books, movies and dreams; a few weeks earlier he had a vivid dream of a medieval castle with a labyrinth of puzzles and traps, and made sketches/notes. Music is a big part of his life; he played guitar when younger but not recently, likes rock. He just started streaming games (no details yet; John is eager to hear more).

As of 20 September 2022: James streamed a game on 19 September 2022 and got lots of nice comments from the community, which inspired him to keep going. He likes 2D puzzle adventures like Zelda and offered to test John's mobile game (John will tell him when testing is ready). He also reads a game dev magazine with tutorials and developer interviews. His week was okay; he's trying to balance work and other activities.

As of 3 October 2022: James got a new video card the week before (~26 Sep 2022) and is eager to play RPGs on it; he asked John about Cyberpunk 2077 and, on John's recommendation, plans to play it and report back.

As of 13 October 2022: James released his first game to the gaming community recently and found it fulfilling to see players enjoy it; The Witcher 3 was a major inspiration (its world and story). He plans to make more games in different genres and test new ideas.

As of 21 October 2022: James lost apartment power ~18 Oct 2022 mid-game and lost unsaved progress. His mother visited with an army friend ~19 Oct 2022. His first console was a Nintendo (Super Mario, Zelda), which sparked his gaming passion. He started Cyberpunk 2077 on 20 Oct 2022 and finds it addictive; John advised that dialogue choices matter and you needn't befriend every character. John promised to send him programming resources/tutorials from his seminar; James wants to branch out in programming.

As of 31 October 2022: James and Samantha decided to move in together and rented an apartment near McGee's bar (a favorite spot; the bar was a factor in choosing).

As of 5 November 2022: James started a road trip with family and his dogs on 4 November 2022. He wants to try the sports genre and will practice FIFA 23 (John's recommendation) before playing with John; John sent him chess opening resources at his request.

As of 7 November 2022: on the road trip James visited friends Josh and Mark and an animal sanctuary with rescue dogs; he resisted adopting, feeling more than three dogs is too much. He wants to try John's online board game demo when released and give feedback; John will tell him.

Joint plans (as of 17 March 2022): possibly build a mobile app together for dog walking and pet care connecting owners with reliable walkers, personalised with each pup's preferences. They agreed to try VR gaming together on Saturday 26 March 2022 (unconfirmed whether it happened). John also suggested arcades and slot machines.
